sloka: अहं राक्षसराजेन रावणेन महात्मना।आज्ञप्तः समरे हन्तुं तावुभौ रामलक्ष्मणौ ।। ६.७८.१० ।।
transliteration: ahaṁ rākṣasarājena rāvaṇena mahātmanā।ājñaptaḥ samare hantuṁ tāvubhau rāmalakṣmaṇau ।। 6.78.10 ।।

translations.english: "I will kill both Rama and Lakshmana in the battle, by the order of Ravana, the king of Rakshasas."
